action-block.title: Check of the aural and visual warnings associated with the GPWS basic modes and the Predictive GPWS functions:

command.para: Check that the GPWS (or the TAWS) aural and visual warnings are operative. .

note.para: On ground, the GPWS can be tested by pressing this pushbutton. If the pushbutton is pressed briefly, some of the aural warnings sound and pushbutton captions, related to the GPWS, come on. If the pushbutton is pressed continuously, then all the aural warnings sound.
